description: Checks MTA-STS for a mail domain: the _mta-sts TXT record (v=STSv1 and id) and the HTTPS policy file (mode enforce, testing or none, the MX patterns and max_age). Reports whether the record and the policy are both present and whether the policy's version is valid. Does not test the mail servers themselves. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_mta_sts_validator
title: Security Mta Sts Validator
